name: black-lace-intimate-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: Private lifestyle moodboard and bedroom selfie visual

prompt.project_info: Create a soft realistic bedroom mirror selfie with calm intimate domestic atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with dark-blonde-to-brown hair in a loose ponytail and face-framing strands, light makeup, and a neutral confident expression. She wears a black lace-trimmed camisole with opaque matching lounge shorts, a black choker, and a delicate silver pendant necklace, seated casually on a bed while holding a smartphone that partially obscures her face.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 chest-level mirror-selfie composition with asymmetrical framing and the top of the head partially cropped. Include a dark gray upholstered headboard, wrinkled light-pink sheets, and the edge of a black mirror frame. Preserve believable phone reflection logic.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even diffused bedroom ambient light with gentle highlights on lace and natural skin texture, quiet private evening mood without dramatic studio flash.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone mirror-selfie look, 3:4 portrait, slight downward angle, sharp realistic detail with mild background falloff, subtle digital noise, natural color and skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A soft realistic 3:4 bedroom mirror selfie of one approved adult woman with dark-blonde-to-brown hair in a loose ponytail and messy face-framing strands, light makeup, and a calm confident expression. She wears a black lace-trimmed camisole with opaque matching lounge shorts, a black choker, and a delicate silver pendant necklace, seated casually on a bed while holding a smartphone that partially obscures her face. Include a dark gray upholstered headboard, wrinkled light-pink sheets, and the edge of a black mirror frame. Maintain accurate reflection logic, asymmetrical framing, soft diffused ambient light, realistic lace and skin texture, slight digital noise, and a quiet intimate bedroom atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent lingerie, g-string, sexualized pose, fetish framing, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
